description: This file defines a middleware class ExceptionMiddleware for handling exceptions in an ASP.NET Core web application. It intercepts unhandled exceptions during HTTP request processing and returns JSON-formatted error details, with special handling for DuplicateException.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for catching and handling exceptions during HTTP request processing.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes the middleware logic, catching exceptions during request processing.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting appropriate HTTP status codes and writing error details as JSON.
